sources.snippet: 🧠 Food-Image-Classification-AI-Model A Food image classification model fine-tuned on the Food-101 dataset using the powerful facebook/deit-base-patch16-224 architecture. This model classifies images into one of 101 popular food categories such as pizza, ramen, pad thai, sushi, and more.
